posts.name: Eric Balchunas
posts.text: My first official book intv w/ Natalie who got early copy. Covered a lot of ground. Main thrust: Bitcoin is in a transition period, like most 18yr olds. Huge feat to make it this far, penetrate Wall Street, the govt, get ETF-ized, attract Boomers and become legit asset class. Some things that will help it grow from here IMO: decreasing volatility and correlation, fighting harder to 'own' the messaging as solution to affordability problem (which is only going to get worse) and fending off any quantum/AI threats and/or replacement networks. This is why we almost called the book Bitcoin Grows Up.

quoted.text:
My favorite episode with @EricBalchunas yet.

Ahead of his new book with @JSeyff, he walked me through his path from skeptic to Bitcoin believer, what his mom said the first time she heard about Bitcoin, what happened when he actually tried self-custody, and the inside story of how BlackRock’s ETF almost never got filed at all.

We also got into why he calls Bitcoin a teenager, what Jack Bogle and Bitcoiners have in common, whether the government ends up buying stocks, and who he thinks is quietly stealing Bitcoin’s best argument.
